title: Online Exam Portal
description: A web-based examination platform for creating, scheduling and grading assessments, with secure timed test delivery and real-time result processing.

title: Therapy Scheduling Platform
description: A scheduling platform for mental-health clinicians to manage client appointments, session notes and availability — streamlining therapy workflows end to end. Backend built as a serverless app of 13 Azure Functions in raw Python.

title: Support Worker Allocation System
description: Enterprise software that matches and assigns support workers to elderly clients across Australia based on skills, location and availability for aged-care providers.

title: Facility Management App
description: Cross-platform React Native app used by 2,000+ field technicians, featuring offline-first data sync, encrypted local storage, barcode scanning and media capture for reliable operation without connectivity.

title: Customer Handling App
description: Mobile CRM for field teams with live visit tracking, service-escalation workflows, digital signature capture and automatic retry-based sync to keep records consistent across devices.

title: Attendance App
description: Workforce attendance app with GPS geofencing, QR-code validation and offline logging, enabling accurate check-in/check-out for remote and low-connectivity work sites.

title: Hybrid WebView Mobile App
description: Packaged existing web-based enterprise systems into native iOS and Android apps using react-native-webview, with a hybrid architecture and optimized rendering for smooth performance.
